name: tailcat
description: like netcat, but over Tailscale's data plane, without Tailscale's control plane
one_liner: A tool that lets two computers connect to each other securely and directly over the internet, without needing a Tailscale account or any special network setup.
buyer: Honestly this is a networking/infra engineer's utility — not something a typical small business would buy on its own.
business_use_cases: A DevOps engineer uses it for ad-hoc secure file transfer or debugging between two machines during an incident.
A hosting provider offers it as a built-in 'quick secure connect' feature between customer virtual machines.

money_ideas.idea: Wrap it in a simple client and sell it to IT support freelancers as a 'connect into any client machine instantly, no VPN setup' tool.

steal_this: Wrap it in a simple GUI and pitch it to IT freelancers as an instant, no-setup remote-support tool.
